items.quote: Six months without closing a deal - here's the brutal truth about why agents fail.
items.statement: Agents fail because they act as information desks instead of trusted advisors.

items.quote: Because clients don't buy facts. They buy feelings. They buy the feeling that you understand their fear of making the wrong investment.
items.statement: Clients buy the feeling that you understand their fear of making the wrong investment.

items.quote: Your job isn't to be the smartest person in the room. Your job is to be the most trustworthy.
items.statement: Stop leading with what you know and start leading with what clients need to feel safe.
